scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agency-os/shared build && pnpm --filter @agency-os/api build && pnpm --filter agency-os-web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @agency-os/shared lint && pnpm --filter @agency-os/api lint && pnpm --filter agency-os-web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agency-os/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @agency-os/api typecheck && pnpm --filter agency-os-web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agency-os/shared test && pnpm --filter @agency-os/api test && pnpm --filter agency-os-web test
scripts.ci:quality: pnpm test:requirements && pnpm extension:check && pnpm build && pnpm test:contracts:run && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high
scripts.ci:database: pnpm --filter @agency-os/api... build && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed:verify && pnpm db:check && pnpm test:integration
